listing.name: Hydro Thunder Hurricane — Hydro Thunder Hurricane: Recompiled (visibou)
listing.summary: Upstream documents startup to the title screen and some features. Race and progression support remain unknown. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Hydro Thunder Hurricane Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. This guide does not specify the exact supported region, revision or file hash. Check the project’s original-file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build the CMake project with its included generated C++. Supply your own Hydro Thunder data and follow upstream’s local conversion and setup instructions.

warnings: Upstream documents startup to the title screen and some features. Race and progression support remain unknown.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
